title: Foundation model and generative AI yield 3CL protease inhibitors confirmed at sub-micromolar IC50
summary: A workflow combining generative models, the MMELON foundation model and filters selected 249 molecules from about 5 million generated. Eighteen were checked with free energy perturbation, and five of those were tested experimentally: all five retained on-target inhibition with IC50 below 1 micromolar, and one showed stronger inhibition than its lead. MMELON reached Pearson R = 0.72 on a blind test.
ai_technology: MMELON biomedical foundation model with generative molecular models

evidence.tested: Five selected molecules were tested for 3CL protease inhibition, all retaining on-target inhibition with IC50 below 1 micromolar; 18 molecules were checked with free energy perturbation.
evidence.unknown: Proprietary dataset used for thresholds; the abstract does not state the number of experimental replicates or the full set of tested compounds.
evidence.ai_role: Generative models produced candidate molecules; the MMELON foundation model predicted activity and supported downselection.
